issue_request: FHIR-15847 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking to remove or leave off the isModifier flag from the Observation time-offset extension because the extension does not alter interpretation of the containing element in the way modifier extensions do.
initial_application: Git commit b437a5fdc0b21d669e05f8854231006deac215f7 explicitly mentions GF#15847 and removed the populated Is Modifier value from the time-offset row in source/observation/observation-extensions-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: Current core has no active source definition for observation-timeOffset; source/fhir.ini has no active entry and source only retains the OID mapping. R4/R4B historical bundles show isModifier false, while the archived STU3 bundle remains historical output. The extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, where its StructureDefinition has no isModifier element.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current core build has no active time-offset extension definition to correct and the current Extension Pack definition is already non-modifier.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same pre-application commit as a separate extension modifier cleanup, but not decided because it concerns a different artifact.
